rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMISSION ON AUDIT TO EXAMINE THE BOOKS OF ACCOUNTS OF ALL PRIVATE CORPORATIONS, PARTNERSHIPS, ASSOCIATIONS ENDOWED WITH CORPORATE OR JURIDICAL PERSONALITY AVAILING OF LOANS AND/OR FINANCIAL GUARANTEES FROM GOVERNMENT CORPORATIONS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares it the policy of the State to promote the highest standards of conduct in the public service and to ensure that public officials entrusted with the people's money exercise circumspection and fiduciary trust and responsibility.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1995-07-31

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 7183  AND PROHIBITING THE MANUFACTURE OF DEADLY FIRECRACKERS, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Penalizes the person, firm or association caught manufacturing or exploding these deadly firecrackers: "Super Lolo, Thunders, Baby Dynamites, etc, --- with imprisonment of three (3) months to one (1) year, and a fine of P50,000.00.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10532

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING MEMBERS OF THE LAW ENFORCEMENT AND INVESTIGATIVE AGENCIES OF THE GOVERNMENT FROM RECEIVING DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY REWARD MONEY OFFERED FOR THE SOLUTION OF A CRIME, AND PROVIDING PENAL SANCTIONS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Proposes that a REWARDS SYSTEM be set up and institutionaliz ed in all the law enforcement and investigative agencies involved in the investigation of any crime so as to ensure speedy prosecution. Imposes the fine of P50,000.00 and imprisonment of six (6) to 12 years with perpetual disqualificatio n from office for violation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1995-07-31

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT PENALIZING ANY GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL WHO REFUSES TO RELEASE IMMEDIATELY A DETAINED PRISONER WHO HAS POSTED BAIL AND/OR CLEARED OF CHARGES BY COMPETENT AUTHORITIES
rows.abstract: Penalizes the government officials found violation this Act with imprisonment equivalent  to the penalty provided by law for the crime charged against the detained person and a fine of not less than P30,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-31

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DECLARE ALL DISPOSABLE LANDS OF THE GOVERNMENT WHICH HAVE REMAINED IDLE AND SUITABLE FOR RESIDENTIAL PURPOSE  SHALL BE DEVELOPED INTO SOCIALIZED HOUSING SITE FOR LOW-SALARIED GOVERNMENT AND PRIVATE EMPLOYEES AND ALSO SQUATTERS
rows.abstract: Directs the National Housing Authority to conduct a survey of idle government lands in coordination with the DENR, afterwhich it shall publish the areas for socialized housing projects and thereafter allocate the lands to qualified applicants.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1995-07-31

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING RETIREMENT, PENSION AND OTHER BENEFITS UPON REACHING RETIREMENT AGE OR EARLIER SEPARATED FROM THE SERVICE ALLOWED UNDER EXISTING LAWS, TO ALL OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE NATIONAL AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS, EITHER APPOINTIVE OR ELECTIVE, INCLUDING THOSE OF THE GOVERNMENT- OWNED AND -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS WHO HAVE RENDERED AN AGGREGATE ALTHOUGH NON-CONTINUOUS AND BROKEN PUBLIC SERVICE FOR AT LEAST TEN (10) YEARS UPON A RECONSTITUTION OF THEIR SERVICE RECORDS AND OTHER PERTINENT DOCUMENTS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Directs the creation of a SPECIAL GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES FUND (SGEF) to pay off the benefits provided for in this Act. Explains the details whereby one can avail of the benefits under this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

first_reading.comm_act: joint ref'ls as per J. 69; p. 43

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE SOCIAL SECURITY SYSTEM TO GRANT INCREASED SALARY LOANS TO ITS MEMBERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Directs the SSS to grant to every member an ordinary loan equivalent to FIVE (5) months, or a loan equivalent to TEN (10) months if the member has been a victim of a serious calamity.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07758

rows.author: A051
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING THE EDUCATIONAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS FOR INDIGENOUS CULTURAL COMMUNITIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Vests with the DECS the authority to systematize, administer, and implement the NATIONAL INTEGRATION SCHOLARSHIP GRANT PROGRAM (NISGP), the SELECTED ETHNIC GROUPS EDUCATONAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (SEAGEP), and other government study grants available exclusively for deserving members of the indigenous communities. Requires , however, the full participation of the (1) Office for Northern Cultural Communities (ONCC), the Office for Southern Cultural Communities (OSSC), and the Office for Muslim Affairs (OMA).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE THROUGH PUBLIC AUCTION OF CONFISCATED SMUGGLED TOBACCO AND TOBACCO PRODUCTS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: States that the Bureau of Custom is PROHIBITED from selling through pubic auction confiscated smuggled tobacco and tobacco products; penalizes violation of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07406

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC RELEASE TO THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS (LGUs) OF THEIR TWENTY PER CENTUM (20%) SHARE OF THE NATIONAL REVENUE TAXES, AMENDING SECTION 282 PARAGRAPH B OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE FOR THIS PURPOSE
rows.abstract: Authorizes the local government BIR chiefs to deduct from the annual internal revenue tax collections an amount equivalent to the percentage provided for and to remit the same to the LGUs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EXPANSION/IMPRO VEMENT OF THE SLAUGHTERHOUSE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PIDDIG, PROVINCE OF ILOCOS NORTE
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM THE PAYMENT OF INCOME TAX NON-RESIDENT FILIPINO CITIZENS WHOSE INCOME FROM FOREIGN SOURCES DOES NOT EXCEED U.S. $9,000, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 21 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE
rows.abstract: Substantiates the government's appreciation and recognition of these nonresident citizen's contributions to our foreign exchange and "in keeping the battered economy afloat."
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING OWNERS OR OPERATORS OF PUBLIC UTILITY VEHICLES TO PROVIDE THEIR VEHICLES WITH SUFFICIENT WASTE DISPOSAL CONTAINERS AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Penalizes the owner or operator who fails to comply with a fine of not less than P500.00 nor more than P1,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE THROUGH PUBLIC AUCTION OF CONFISCATED SMUGGLED GARLIC AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: PROHIBITS the Bureau of Customs from selling confiscated smuggled garlic through public auction; penalizes violation of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07407

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ADVERTISEMENTS FOR THE ENDORSEMENT OF PRODUCTS, GOODS AND SERVICES BE IN PILIPINO
rows.abstract: Provides penalty for violation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING CALAMITY VICTIMS WHO ARE MEMBERS OF THE GSIS AND SSS A LOW INTEREST RATE FOR HOUSING AND OTHER FORMS OF LOANS AND BENEFITS WHICH A MEMBER MAY AVAIL OF, AND FOR SUCH OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines "CALAMITY" as used in this proposed measure; states that interest rate for housing and other forms of loans and benefits SHOULD NOT EXCEED NINE PERCENT (9%) per annum.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING CIVIL SERVICE ELIGIBILITY, UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, TO MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES WHO HAVE RENDERED AT LEAST THREE YEARS OF HONORABLE SERVICE IN THE MILITARY
rows.abstract: Requires all military personnel who are qualified under this Act to secure from the Deputy Chief of Staff for Personnel of the AFP a certification to the effect that they have rendered the service as provided for in this proposed measure.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09545

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING EDUCATIONAL PROGRAM FOR THE BARANGAY CAPTAINS (PUNONG BARANGAY) AND COUNCILMEN (KAGAWAD) TO BE KNOWN AS ASSISTANCE TO BARANGAY LEADERS FOR THE ADVANCEMENT OF THE NATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Directs the DECS to draw up the necessary curriculum to this effect, and which shall be offered by all government colleges and universities; prescribes the qualification for one to avail of the Program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING BONUSES, REPRESENTATION AND TRANSPORTATION ALLOWANCES, CASH GIFTS AND TIPS FORM THE COMPUTATION OF INDIVIDUAL INCOME TAX RETURNS
rows.abstract: Increases the purchasing powers of the compensation of all employees thus making life easier for them in the light of the prevailing economic difficulties. Exempts their bonuses, representation and transportation allowances, cash gifts and tips fromthe computation of their gross incomes as bases for individual income taxation. Does not apply to employees occupying managerial positions, with a monthly compensation of P20,000.00.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE LAOAG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT AUTHORITY TRANSFERRING EXISTING ASSETS OF THE LAOAG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT TO THE AUTHORITY, VESTING THE AUTHORITY WITH POWER TO ADMINISTER AND OPERATE THE LAOAG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Approved on Third Reading on 1997-11-24

second_reading.remarks: Considered the Explanatory Note as the Sponsorship Speech

rows.title_full: AN ACT FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A PIER AND WHARFAGE FACILITIES AT BARANGAY SAOIT-PAGALI, IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF BURGOS, PROVINCE OF ILOCOS NORTE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ORGANIZATION OF THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN
rows.abstract: Declares it a State policy to uphold and maintain an efficient and service-oriente d bureaucracy and to promote honesty, integrity, and high standards of ethics in the public service. Creates an independent Office of the Ombudsman composed of (a) the Ombudsman to be known as Tanodbayan; (b) one over-all Deputy; (c) at least on Deputy each for Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao; and (d) a separate Deputy for the military establishment. States that whenever necessary, Regional Tanodbayan may likewise be appointed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT ABOLISHING THE BUREAU OF EQUIPMENT OF THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS
rows.abstract: States that all existing construction and maintenance equipment and ancillary facilities in the Department of Publc Works and Highways shall be disposed and sold to the private sector thereby giving the contractors within the region where the equipment are located prior right to purchase the same.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE UNAUTHORIZED CONVERSION OF COCONUT FARMS INTO OTHER AGRICULTURAL USES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to regulate the conversion of coconut planted agricultural lands into other uses thereby implementing measures designed to conserve and protect the resources devoted to the coconut industry. Allows, however, such conversion in cases where it is shown that majority of the coconut trees in the subject land have become senescent and economically unproductive as determined by the Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 2 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7041, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT REQUIRING REGULAR PUBLICATION OF EXISTING VACANT POSITIONS IN GOVERNMENT OFFICES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFORE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Refers to RA 7041 which requires the regular publication of existing vacant positions in government offices, which law has adversely affected the public schoolteachers. Amends RA 7401 by excluding public schoolteachers, both elementary and secondary, from its coverage.
rows.status: Business for the day on 1997-12-09

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING, PLANNING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "National Housing Act of 1995" Establishes and institutionaliz es the Department of HOusing, Planning and Urban Development, and administrative machinery that will formulate and coordinate all shelter policies and administer, manage and supervise all existing and future shelter programs and projects.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09824

first_reading.comm_act: joint referrals as per J. 58; p. 43

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING CERTAIN PARCEL OF LAND IN THE CITY OF MANILA, WHICH IS RESERVED AS COMMUNAL PROPERTY, INTO DISPOSABLE OR ALIENABLE LAND OF THE STATE, PROVIDING FOR ITS SUBDIVISION AND SALE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AN EFFICIENT AND EXPIDITIOUS SYSTEM OF DISPOSING SEIZED ILLEGAL DRUGS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOES THE DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT OF 1972
rows.abstract: States that the SEIZED PROHIBITED DRUGS SHALL BE TESTED, WEIGHED AND DESTROYED WITHIN TWENTY FOUR (24) HOURS UPON CONFISCATION, IN THE PRESENCE OF AT LEAST ONE REPRESENTATIVE EACH FROM DULY RECOGNIZED NON-GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATION (NGOs), RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATIONS, MEDIA AND DANGEROUS DRUGS BOARD. Provides, however that a maximum of ten (10%) per cent of the seized prohibited drugs shall be kept by the National Bureau of Investigation for testing purposes and as evidence.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10084

rows.title_full: AN ACT SETTING ASIDE PHILIPPINE AMUSEMENT AND GAMING CORPORATION (PAGCOR) FUNDS FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ADEQUATE DRUG REHABILITATION CENTERS IN THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Allocates Five Million (5,000.000.00) Pesos every month from the funds generated by the PAGCOR for the purpose of establishing adequate drug rehabilitation centers in the country.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10084

first_reading.comm_act: change of ctte. ref'l from Games & Amusements as per J. 25; Sept. 25, 1995

rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE BENEFITS AND INCENTIVES OF BARANGAY TANOD MEMBERS WHO HAVE RENDERED AT LEAST ONE YEAR OF SERVICE IN THE BARANGAY GOVERNMENT
rows.abstract: Entitles the barangay tanod members who have rendered for at least one (1) year in the barangay, aside from the privileges already granted by the Local Government Code, to the following: (a) Christmas Bonus of at least one-half (1/2) of what the punong barangay shall receive; (b) insurance coverage equal to three-fourths (3/4) of that received by the punong barangay; (c) free legal services from the government lawyers for criminal and civil cases filed against him arising from acts committed inthe performance of their duties; (d) fifty (50%) per cent discount in tuition and matriculation fees for their legitimate dependent children attending state colleges and universities; and (e) preference in the availment of membership in barangay livvelihood and development projects.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-31

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INCLUSION OF ABACA PLANTING IN THE GOVERNMENT REFORESTATION PROGRAM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Includes abaca planting in the government's reforestation program. States that there is need for the government to hasten the abaca expansion through the use of upland and the mountainous areas and that abaca can be intercropped with timber trees and pulp woods which will also help augment the income of small farmers and individual landowners engaged in tree planting.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1995-07-31

rows.author: A022
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE RESEARCH, CONTROL AND PREVENTION PROGRAMS ON DIABETES MELLITUS, PROVIDING FOR THE CREATION OF A NATIONAL COMMISSION  ON DIABETES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The National Diabetes Act of 1994" Provides for an effective research on the prevention and treatment of Diabetes Mellitus. Creates the National Commission of Diabetes which shall formulate a long-range plan to combat the disease, including research programs and studies for the investigation of the epidemiology, prevention and control of the disease.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07271

rows.author: A073
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A VENTURE CAPITAL FUND FOR LOCAL AND FOREIGN TECHNOLOGY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Creates a technology venture capital fund for the commercializati on, utilization and development of local and foreign technology and for the purpose, a private sector group shall administer the fund and provide for the schemes by which the fund should be handled.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07267

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF ELECTION PROPAGANDA IN MASS MEDIA UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE, SUBPARAGRAPH (B) OF SECTION ELEVEN OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBER 6646, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ELECTORAL REFORMS LAW OF 1987 AND SECTION 85 (E) OF BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 881 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Allows political parties and independent candidates to buy air time and print space but with approval by the COMELEC. Seeks to restore the right , access and use of mass media for election propaganda under certain conditions. Aims to provide the electorate with a borader understanding of various electoral issues, as well as more bases in choosing their candidates for elective positions.

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 2209 OF THE CIVIL CODE SO AS TO INCREASE THE LEGAL INTEREST FROM SIX PERCENT (6%) TO TWELVE PERCENT (12%) PER ANNUM
